text:
nina: Heads-up — HyperNova (acct HN-330) has INV-2026-298 for $31,860 overdue. We sent dunning emails on 1987648000 and 1987651200. Customer responded claiming a billing anomaly and asked for a breakdown and a temporary hold on collections. @rob can you review?

rob: Paste invoice lines? Want to check for any trial credits or promo adjustments. If it's a legit dispute we should pause hard collections while we audit.

nina: Pasting export (redacted):

```
INV-2026-298
- Reserved GPU capacity: $18,000
- Peak token overage: $13,500
- Support plan: $360
- Credits applied: -$0
Total: $31,860
```

nina: Customer says the overage is from a 20-hour job that retried due to a misrouted webhook between 2026-03-18T02:00 and 2026-03-19T00:00. They've sent a request list and claim they will remediate.

henry: Our ingestion logs show duplicated request hashes in that window — looks like retries. Could be client-side, but i'll run a quick trace sample.

rob: Given they're a strategic account, propose a split: 60% now, 40% in 30 days, plus a small admin fee 1.25%. Condition acceptance on a signed remediation attestation plus PO/ACH. If audit finds platform fault we refund or credit. Thoughts @alexa?

alexa: I'm OK with a managed split but want to avoid setting a precedent. Add a clause: acceptance is not admission of liability, and credits require RevEng audit. Also require them to enable a read-only trace link for our team for 7 days.

nina: Draft customer message:

"We acknowledge your dispute re INV-2026-298 and can offer a managed split payment: 60% ($19,175.25) due within 7 days and 40% ($12,785.35) due in 30 days. A 1.25% administrative fee has been added. This offer requires (1) signed remediation attestation within 72 hours, (2) ACH or PO before the first payment, and (3) access to a read-only tracing link for the incident window. Any credit requests will be evaluated after our technical audit; if we determine the platform was at fault we will issue a pro-rated credit. Acceptance of this plan does not waive our right to pursue collections if facts are misrepresented. Please respond within 72 hours to accept."

rob: Numbers check: total = $31,860 * 1.0125 = $32,259.75; 60% = $19,355.85? Wait math: can you confirm Nina?
nina: Updated calc: total with fee = $32,259.75. 60% = $19,355.85, 40% = $12,903.90. Fixed.

henry: I'll drop the trace snippet by EOD. If our routing had an edge case we reverse the admin fee too.

collections-bot: reminder sent to HyperNova at 1987654500 (email + webhook).

legal-bot: legal check requested by rob at 1987654520. Recommended clause: "acceptance does not constitute waiver of rights" + attach standard deferral template.

alexa: Ok legal signoff on clauses. rob, if you approve send and cc sales + legal.

rob: Approve. Nina, send offer and set a 72h timer. If no response escalate to collections and open a formal ledger hold.

nina: Sent at 1987654578, cc'ing sales/legal. Will update thread when they accept or decline. :white_check_mark:
